INFORMATION / PRIVACY

A straightforward
approach to privacy.

How this website handles the information you choose to share.

Project enquiries

The enquiry form constructs a WhatsApp draft in your browser. It does not submit the form to a Rehvector database. You decide whether to send that draft in WhatsApp. Email and LinkedIn links open the corresponding external services.

External services

This site is hosted with Sites. Fonts may load from Google Fonts. WhatsApp, LinkedIn, GitHub, and embedded project media are governed by their providers’ privacy practices. Hosting providers may process technical request information.

What to share

Share a high-level brief first. Do not include passwords, confidential datasets, or personal records in an initial enquiry. Data access, approved providers, and retention requirements are agreed separately for each project.

Contact

For a question about information you have shared, email shakeelrana6240@gmail.com.
